verified: Complete pair inventories have identical paths/modes/blobs except RecoveryStatusView; tests, control script and docs entire bytes exactly equal. Same oracle can be exercised on instrumented native-bordered baseline and custom-style candidate; no actual paired native outcome inferred

Full actual shared Retry source read. Same retry hostIDs, reconnect method, disabled latch, accessibilityLabel/identifier, shared Home/NeedsYou ownership and compact/AX ViewThatFits layout. Actual Button uses custom style, text padding12x6/Capsule tintSoft/outer vertical4/min44/contentShape; details Retry and other styles unchanged

DEBUG seams read actual Button/card global frames and hide entire Retry through opacity without authored frame changes; no production seam callback is supplied. Paired baseline carries same seam. Actions are not invoked during geometry measurement and service.calls must remain empty

Geometry uses >8 per-channel shown-hidden pixel difference seeded in Retry frame and eight-neighbour flood traversal; bounds and coverage derive from actual changed members. Unrelated disconnected regions outside target cannot alone satisfy oracle

Corrected metric rejects nonfinite/nonempty rectangle failures, requires painted bounds inside card in both axes and inside target, label within painted bounds, at least44 target, shorter paint than target, <=36 default height, <=2.6 label heights, aspect>=1.6, >=4 top/bottom clearance

Corrected enclosure requires min of all four 1-to3pt bands outside recognized label to have >=.9 changed-member coverage; glyph-only rectangle no longer passes. This is enclosure of sampled paint, not mathematical capsule-shape equivalence

Independently ran exact candidate script: BANNER_ACTION_GEOMETRY_CONTROLS PASS, with previous outside-card/glyph-only negatives, alternate colors, unrelated/disconnected patches, oversized/default/AX shapes and nonfinite samples

Additional reviewer exact-source CoreGraphics scenes reject original af930 outside-card narrower200pt card and original glyph-only case; each individually missing enclosure band rejects; all four invalid metric fields and NaN/infinite/nonpositive scales reject; .899 enclosure rejects and .9 admits
Exact DEBUG frontend parses of test and view, Bash syntax and paired diff whitespace checks pass. No SDK typecheck or native compile/run performed
limits: SOURCE_ONLY. Synthetic label rectangles supplied by controls are not authentic OCR, UIKit/SwiftUI/glass rendering or actual baseline-fail/candidate-pass evidence. Neither direction of rendering error is excluded by synthetic tests alone

Actual pair must execute same tests and retain shown/hidden captures, real recognized Retry box, measured card/target/paint/enclosure and reasoned baseline failure/candidate pass. No color-only synthetic pass substitutes for paired native result

Pixel difference detects changes, not semantic ownership or all capsule geometry: multiple components inside the target are seeded and unioned. Four enclosure strips plus aspect/height do not prove an exact capsule perimeter or continuity everywhere; production Capsule source supplies intended shape

Shown and hidden captures are sequential. Equal reported frames do not prove unrelated material/glass/animation stayed pixel-identical; changed material inside or touching seed may inflate paint, low contrast/antialiasing or matching background may erase paint. Both false acceptance and rejection remain possible pending authentic captures

Global SwiftUI geometry and UIKit window pixels/OCR conversion require actual coordinate calibration. First matching OCR Retry in crop is not a native identifier/unique-semantic identity proof. Rect validation is not a formal arbitrary-oversized-coordinate or malformed-framework-output safety proof

Geometry fixture currently light Clubhouse at Large and accessibility5, enabled. Source min44/contentShape, disabled latch and accessibilityLabel are not observed native hit/activation/VoiceOver, compact wrapping, disabled/pressed/other-theme foreground contrast or device/layout proof

Custom opacity affects foreground and background (.45 disabled/.6 pressed); no numeric or rendered contrast acceptance inferred. Existing UI coverage mentioned by docs is not current-head execution proof

No local native/SUT/simulator/FIFO/package/SDK build/CI/PR/shared-ref action or original-image audit by reviewer; original failures retained. No permission to bypass independent exact proof or landing checks
